name: 数独生成器 / 求解器

map.数独生成器 / 求解器是做什么的？: What does Sudoku Generator / Solver do?
map.如何使用数独生成器 / 求解器？: How do I use Sudoku Generator / Solver?
map.数独生成器 / 求解器适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Sudoku Generator / Solver best for?
map.数独为 9×9 网格分 9 个 3×3 宫，约束为每行、每列、每宫均含 1 至: Sudoku is a 9x9 grid divided into 9 blocks of 3x3; the constraint is that each row, column and block contains 1-9 without repetition. Generation first fills a valid solution by backtracking (trying 1-9 per cell and checking constraints), then digs holes by difficulty (easy keeps ~36-45 given, hard ~26-30) and verifies a unique solution; solving uses backtracking with candidate pruning.
map.休闲练习：选难度一键生成题目，附参考答案。: Casual practice: pick difficulty to generate a puzzle with one click, with a reference answer.
map.求解辅助：粘贴卡住的题目，工具回溯求解给出完整盘。: Solve aid: paste a stuck puzzle and the tool backtracks to give the full grid.
map.教学演示：理解约束满足与回溯算法。: Teaching demo: understand constraint satisfaction and backtracking algorithms.
map.9×9 盘面，生成时按难度挖空并保证唯一解；求解用回溯法逐格试数满足行/列/宫不: On a 9x9 board, generation digs holes by difficulty and guarantees a unique solution; solving uses backtracking to try numbers cell by cell satisfying no-repeat in row/column/block. Pasted puzzles can also be solved in reverse.
map.难度对应挖空数：简单≈40 格、中等≈50、困难≈55+（共 81 格）。合法完: Holes by difficulty: easy ~40, medium ~50, hard ~55+ (of 81 cells). Valid complete Sudoku grids number about 6.67x10^21; the generator guarantees a unique solution per puzzle to avoid multi-solution disputes.
map.生成的题一定唯一解吗？: Is the generated puzzle guaranteed unique?
map.是。生成流程会校验唯一解，确保有且仅有一个合法填法。: Yes. The generation flow verifies uniqueness, ensuring exactly one valid filling.
map.可通过挖空数选难度；极难可手动再挖，但过多可能破坏唯一解。: Choose difficulty by number of holes; for extreme difficulty you can dig more manually, but too many may break uniqueness.
map.数独生成器 / 求解器。娱乐游戏工具，纯前端实现，无需安装，离线可玩。: Sudoku Generator / Solver. An entertainment game tool, pure front-end, no install, playable offline.
